audit_issues.message: 지원 기관 또는 사업을 선택한 이유가 답변에 드러나지 않습니다.
교열 기준을 넘는 문체 위험이 3개 문항에서 발견되었습니다.

current_v22.comparison_note: The two new txt files are prompt sources only; no executed output was attached, so this is a prompt-design comparison, not a new output-quality score.

feature_coverage_review.note: New prompts request sources/evidence in prose but do not define package IDs, claim IDs, statuses, or machine-readable references.
New company prompt explicitly covers customers, value, revenue/performance, substitutes, competitors, strategy, risks, culture and job bridge.
New company prompt asks for current dates and source priority, but not legal-entity fields, frozen manifest, data package, or hard-fail statuses.
New self-intro prompt strongly separates personal action, team result, authority and unsupported numbers; it still lacks deterministic claim validation.
New self-intro prompt has no four-candidate, three-judge, synthesis, or actual-question-set X/Y protocol.
New self-intro prompt has detailed sentence-object agreement, noun-list reduction, abstract-word replacement, repetition and read-aloud checks.
New company prompt produces expected questions and reverse questions; new self-intro prompt supports defensible prose but does not define D3/D4, cards, probes or a final packet.
New self-intro has output modes and character-count reporting, but both new files remain freeform text prompts without a JSON schema.

recommendation.new_company_prompt: Use as a research-content brief before/alongside 04_기업직무조사.json. Add its business-model, customer/market, substitute, recent-performance, strategy-success-condition, risk, expected-question and stopping criteria fields to the structured contract; do not let its prose output bypass claim/source validation.
recommendation.new_selfintro_prompt: Use as a natural-Korean and contribution-boundary post-editor on a rigorously selected candidate. Run it after candidate selection, then re-run validate_draft, validate_research_evidence, contract validation and audit; do not use it as a replacement for candidate generation/judging/X-Y.
recommendation.best_combination: Existing Career Pipeline contracts + previous rigorous selection + new company research rubric + new self-intro prose rubric + final deterministic revalidation.
